column2: minus the panel and member dead load (panel dead load 1.2 psf). Tributary load width for each member was 4.27 ft

column2: attached at their ends to support beams with 12 gage unstiffened clips; one support beam was free to deflect to avoid catenary forces. End clips were attached to the east member for all tests. No other bracing is reported
column3: so the bracing column is left empty.
